## 👨‍💻 About Me

- 🤖 **AI Engineer at Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs**, building LLM-powered products for real users at scale.
- 🧠 **2+ years of shipping AI/ML products**: RAG pipelines, high-throughput LLM inference, document intelligence and full-stack AI applications.
- 🎓 **B.Tech in Computer Science, NIT Hamirpur (2020 – 2024)**, CGPA 8.9.
- 🏆 **1st place at the GenstormOne 2026 Hackathon.**
- 💡 **800+ DSA problems** solved across LeetCode, GeeksforGeeks and other platforms.
- 🥉 **Bronze medalist at the International Yoga Championship (2017).**
- 🎯 **Building expertise in AI engineering**, going deep on AI infrastructure, production-grade LLM and RAG systems, and agentic architectures that hold up in the real world.
